description: This file defines a GeminiService class that provides methods to interact with the Google Generative AI API, including generating responses based on search context and conversation history, creating session titles, and summarizing documents. It initializes the API with environment variables and configures safety and generation parameters.

classes.name: GeminiService
classes.description: A class encapsulating interaction with Google Generative AI, providing methods to generate responses, titles, and summaries using configured models and context formatting.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes GeminiService, configures API key, model, safety, and generation settings.

methods.name: str _format_context(self, search_results: List[SearchResult])
methods.description: Formats a list of search results into a string context suitable for prompt inclusion.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] _build_conversation_history(self, messages: List[ChatMessage])
methods.description: Builds a list of message dicts representing the last few conversation exchanges for context.

methods.name: str generate_response( self, user_message: str, context: Optional[List[SearchResult]] = None, conversation_history: Optional[List[ChatMessage]] = None )
methods.description: Generates a response to a user message, optionally considering search context and conversation history.

methods.name: str generate_session_title(self, first_message: str, response: str)
methods.description: Produces a concise, descriptive title for a chat session based on initial exchange.

methods.name: str summarize_document(self, text: str, max_length: int = 500)
methods.description: Creates a summary of a provided document text.
